import { documentResearchLimits, prepareDocumentResearch, researchDocuments, renderDocumentResearch, validateDocumentResearch } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';

const frozenPage = 'A complete synthetic page.';
const frozenDocument: ResearchDocumentInput = { id: 'doc-a', title: 'Synthetic document', sha256: 'a'.repeat(64), pages: [{ number: 1, text: frozenPage, sha256: 'b'.repeat(64) }] };
const preparedDocument: PreparedDocumentResearch = prepareDocumentResearch('Question', [frozenDocument]);

}

import { legacy } from './shape.mjs';
const cleanup: SessionCleanup = { complete: true, error: null };
const outcome: SessionOutcome = { ...legacy, cleanup };
const result: ResearchResult = { status: 'complete', answer: outcome.final, receipt: {
  profile: 'quick', model: 'fixture', effort: 'high', provider: null, searches: 0,
  actionCounts: outcome.actionCounts, nativeSessions: 1, stages: outcome.stages,
  termination: outcome.termination, terminal: outcome.terminal, cleanup,
} };
const sources: FrozenSource[] = [{ uri: 'https://example.org', text: 'Captured text' }];
const grounded = groundedAnswer({ sources, judge: { id: 'typed', kind: 'synthetic' }, claims: [{ text: 'Unknown.', citations: [], joint: { verdict: 'insufficient', reason: 'No evidence.' } }] });
validateGrounding(grounded.answer, grounded.grounding);
void groundedResearchQuestion;
void assessGroundedAnswer({ sources, claims: [] }, { identity: grounded.grounding.judge, judge: async () => ({ verdict: 'unknown', reason: 'No judgment.' }) });
async function consumer() {
  const ready = await codexReadiness();
  const direct = await withCodexWorkspace({ lease: '/tmp/typed-example', prefix: 'typed-' }, ws => ws.run({
    prompt: ordinaryResearchPrompt('Question'), live: false, budget: profiles.quick, signal: new AbortController().signal,
  }));
  const research = await researchQuestion('Question', { sources, model: result.receipt.model });
  return [ready.available, sessionCompleted(outcome), direct.cleanup.complete, research.receipt.cleanup.error];
}
void consumer;
import { createMindMap, validateMindMap, reviseMindMap, renderMindMap, mindMapResearch, mindMapLimits } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
import type { ResearchMindMap, MindMapNode, MindMapCitation, MindMapRelation, MindMapEdit, MindMapTree, MindMapTreeNode } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
const relation: MindMapRelation = 'qualifies';
const citation: MindMapCitation = { source: 0, start: 0, end: 13, quote: 'Captured text' };
const mapRoot: MindMapNode = { id: 'root', label: 'Question', relation: null, citations: [], gap: null, children: [
  { id: 'child', label: 'Captured', relation, citations: [citation], gap: null, children: [] },
] };
const mindMap: ResearchMindMap = createMindMap('Question', { sources, root: mapRoot });
const mapEdit: MindMapEdit = { nodes: [{ id: 'child', label: 'A capture' }] };
const editedMap = reviseMindMap(validateMindMap(mindMap), mapEdit);
const mapTree: MindMapTree = JSON.parse(renderMindMap(editedMap, { format: 'tree' }));
const mapTreeNode: MindMapTreeNode = mapTree.nodes[0]!;
void [mapTreeNode.accessibleName, mindMapLimits.nodes];
void mindMapResearch('Question', { sources, activity: event => { const sequence: number = event.sequence; void sequence; } });
// @ts-expect-error unsupported relation
const badMapRelation: MindMapRelation = 'causes';
// @ts-expect-error renderer accepts only the three documented formats
renderMindMap(mindMap, { format: 'html' });
void badMapRelation;
import { exportReportHtml } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
const portableHtml: string = exportReportHtml(createReport(createEvidenceTable('Retention', { sources, columns: [{ id: 'retention', title: 'Retention', question: 'How long?' }] })));
void portableHtml;
// @ts-expect-error a mind map is not report authoring state
exportReportHtml(mindMap);
const lenses = chooseLenses(sources, [perspectiveCandidates(sources)[0]?.id ?? basicFacts.id, { label: 'Renter', focus: 'Costs without building changes' }]);
async function perspectives(): Promise<PerspectiveResult['status']> {
  const viewed = await perspectiveResearch('Topic', { sources, perspectives: 'auto', questions: 2, onLens: ({ id, state }) => void [id, state] });
  return viewed.lenses[0]?.questions?.[0]?.citations[0]?.occurrence === 'exact-retained-span' ? viewed.status : 'failed';
}
void [lenses, perspectives];
const investigationBudget: InvestigationBudget = { ...profiles.quick, calls: 12 };
const investigationQuestion: InvestigationQuestion = { id: 'q1', parentId: null, question: 'What changes?' };
const investigation: Investigation = createInvestigation('Topic', { questions: [investigationQuestion], budget: investigationBudget });
const revisedInvestigation = reviseInvestigation(validateInvestigation(investigation), { scope: 'Offline first' });
const investigationPlan: InvestigationPlan = planInvestigation(revisedInvestigation);
void [renderInvestigation(revisedInvestigation), advanceInvestigation, resumeInvestigation, investigationPlan];
const outline: ResearchOutline | null = null;
void [outline, outlineResearch, validateOutline, reviseOutline, renderOutline];
const tableColumns: EvidenceTableColumn[] = [{ id: 'retention', title: 'Retention', question: 'How long?' }];
const table: ResearchEvidenceTable = createEvidenceTable('Compare', { sources, columns: tableColumns });
const editedTable = reviseEvidenceTable(validateEvidenceTable(table), { question: 'Compare captured values' });
void [renderEvidenceTable(editedTable), evidenceTableResearch];
const report: ResearchReport = createReport(editedTable);
const reviewed: ResearchReport = reviseReport(validateReport(report), { sectionId: 'retention', paragraphs: [{ text: 'Captured retention.', citations: [{ source: 0, start: 0, end: 6, quote: 'Naïve ' }] }] });
const paragraph: ReportParagraph = reviewed.sections[0].versions[0].paragraphs[0];
void [draftReportSection, renderReport(reviewed), paragraph];
const onActivity = (event: ResearchActivity): void => {
  if (event.kind === 'web.completed') { const url: string | null = event.detail.url; void [url, event.detail.urlStatus]; }
  if (event.kind === 'session.settled') { const done: boolean = event.detail.completed; void [done, event.sequence, event.observedAt]; }
};
void [researchQuestion('Typed activity', { activity: onActivity }), researchActivity.kinds, researchActivity.version];

import { documentCoverageLimits, prepareDocumentCoverage, researchDocumentCoverage, validateDocumentCoverage, renderDocumentCoverage } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
import type { PreparedDocumentCoverage, DocumentCoverageResult } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
const coveragePlan: PreparedDocumentCoverage = prepareDocumentCoverage('Question', [frozenDocument], { maxCalls: 4, passUtf16Units: 24000, maxSeconds: 60 });
const coverageRun: Promise<DocumentCoverageResult> = researchDocumentCoverage('Question', [frozenDocument], { confirmedPlanDigest: coveragePlan.planDigest, activity: documentActivity });
function coverageUse(value: unknown): string {
  const result: DocumentCoverageResult = validateDocumentCoverage(value);
  const reviewed: string[] = result.inputCoverage.reviewedWindows;
  const calls: number = result.receipt.startedCalls;
  const cleanup: 'complete' | 'unconfirmed' | 'not_started' = result.receipt.cleanup;
  const answer: 'answered' | 'partial' | 'insufficient' | undefined = result.draft?.coverage;
  void [reviewed, calls, cleanup, answer];
  return renderDocumentCoverage(result);
}
void [coveragePlan, coverageRun, coverageUse, documentCoverageLimits.totalPages];


import {prepareTableQuery, queryTables, validateTableQueryResult, tableQueryLimits} from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
import type {TableQueryPreview, TableQueryResult, TableQueryComplete} from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
declare const queryEngineRoot: string;
const sqlBindings = [{name:'sample',table:suppliedTable}];
const sqlQuery = {sql:'SELECT c0 FROM sample',parameters:[]};
const sqlPreview: TableQueryPreview = prepareTableQuery(sqlBindings, sqlQuery);
const sqlResult: Promise<TableQueryResult> = queryTables(sqlBindings, sqlQuery, {engineRoot:queryEngineRoot});
declare const savedSqlResult: unknown;
const reopenedSql: TableQueryComplete = validateTableQueryResult(savedSqlResult, {tables:sqlBindings});
void [sqlPreview.inputs[0]?.row_column,sqlResult,reopenedSql.result_sha256,tableQueryLimits.rows];

import { createResearchNotebook, reviseResearchNotebook, prepareNotebookQuestion, validateResearchNotebook, renderResearchNotebook, researchNotebookLimits } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
import type { ResearchNotebook, ResearchNotebookQuestionSpec, PreparedNotebookQuestion } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
const notebook: ResearchNotebook = createResearchNotebook('Portable research');
const noteBookWithNote: ResearchNotebook = reviseResearchNotebook(notebook, { type: 'add-note', title: 'Scope', text: 'Use retained sources only.' });
const notebookSpec: ResearchNotebookQuestionSpec = { id: 'question:4f7d831d-fb2b-4a4b-89f4-c06c8f086999', question: 'What is in scope?', sourceIds: [], notes: [{ id: noteBookWithNote.notes[0]!.id, version: 1 }] };
const notebookPreview: PreparedNotebookQuestion = prepareNotebookQuestion(noteBookWithNote, notebookSpec);
const reopenedNotebook: ResearchNotebook = validateResearchNotebook(noteBookWithNote);
void [renderResearchNotebook(reopenedNotebook), notebookPreview.preview.planDigest, researchNotebookLimits.bytes];

import { searchResearchNotebooks, openNotebookSearchHit, notebookSearchLimits } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
import type { NotebookSearchResult, NotebookSearchOptions, NotebookSearchHit } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';
const searchOptions: NotebookSearchOptions = { mode: 'fuzzy', kinds: ['document', 'note'], noteVersions: 'all', limit: 8 };
const searchResult: NotebookSearchResult = searchResearchNotebooks([reopenedNotebook], 'retained', searchOptions);
const searchHit: NotebookSearchHit | undefined = searchResult.hits[0];
if (searchHit) openNotebookSearchHit([reopenedNotebook], searchResult, searchHit.id);
void notebookSearchLimits.engine.sha256;

  researchStudyLimits } from '@pradeeptathineni/research-ai';

const study: ResearchStudy = createResearchStudy('Portable study');
const studyEdit: ResearchStudyEdit = { type: 'deselect-hit', selectionId: 'study-selection:4f7d831d-fb2b-4a4b-89f4-c06c8f086999' };
const editedStudy = reviseResearchStudy(validateResearchStudy(study), studyEdit);
const studySpec: ResearchStudyQuestionSpec = { id: 'study-question:4f7d831d-fb2b-4a4b-89f4-c06c8f086999', question: 'Question', selectionIds: [] };
const studyPreview = null as unknown as PreparedResearchStudyQuestion;
void [checkResearchStudyOrigins, prepareResearchStudyQuestion, recordResearchStudyQuestion, getResearchStudyCitation,
  renderResearchStudy(editedStudy), researchStudyLimits.bytes, studySpec, studyPreview];
